evals.prompt: /factory:inspect with no argument, on a board where card 7 is BLOCKED in In progress and card 9 is REVIEW in In review.
evals.expected_output: The skill runs scripts/stopped.mjs and shows one line per stopped card with stage and reason, and nothing else.
expectations: AC6: the output lists card 7 with BLOCKED and card 9 with REVIEW
AC6: no card is changed and clear.mjs is not run

evals.prompt: /factory:inspect 7 on a BLOCKED card whose stage has a command. The command finishes and the problem is fixed.
evals.expected_output: The skill explains the stop, runs the stage command in this session with the block comment as context, then runs clear.mjs with a one-paragraph solution.
expectations: AC7: the stage command from factory.yml runs through the Skill tool with the block comment after it
AC7: clear.mjs runs once, after the command ended, with a one-paragraph solution

evals.prompt: /factory:inspect 7 on a BLOCKED card. While the stage command runs, the person stops it.
evals.expected_output: The skill does not run clear.mjs and says the card stays blocked.
expectations: AC7: the skill says the card stays blocked
